title: Wall Mount Tumbler Toothbrush Holder 5-Inch Projection Solid Brass, Mambo Collection | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving storage at the sink with this wall mount tumbler toothbrush holder, crafted from solid brass in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. Designed for the Mambo collection, it fits transitional bathroom hardware plans and pairs easily with versatile bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean look
- Multiple designer finish options available
- Installation hardware included

- Projection: 5 in
- Weight capacity: 6 lb
